scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test

DB.description: The app's D1 database. Migrations run on every deploy.

BETTER_AUTH_URL.description: The app's address, e.g. `https://folio.<your-subdomain>.workers.dev` (the subdomain is under **Workers & Pages** in the dashboard), or your own domain. Sign-in only works from this address.

BETTER_AUTH_SECRET.description: 32+ random characters, e.g. from `openssl rand -hex 32`. Signs sessions; changing it signs everyone out.

ENCRYPTION_SECRET.description: 32+ random characters. Encrypts the API secrets of your exchange connections; changing it makes saved secrets unreadable.
